draft.reply_body:
Hello,

A couple of updates before we get to the excavator.

On the concrete breaker damage charge: I've now reviewed the check-out photographs from when the machine was handed over, and they do show the damage was already present before your rental started. Under our policy, no damage charge applies where pre-existing damage is confirmed from the check-out photos, so I'm reversing this charge. Apologies for the frustration this caused — I know you flagged it as urgent and I should have got back to you sooner.

I'm still checking available dates for moving the concrete breaker booking and will follow up on that separately.

On the 13-tonne excavator: we can deliver to your site. Let me know the site address and the dates you need it, and I'll put together the delivery details and come back to you with options.

Best regards,
Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator, Haapaharju Oy
